name: MOP_IMP_PROMO_COUPONS
description: This is the interface table for migrating coupons for promotions from an external data source into fusion. The WHO columns in this table, just reflects when the data was loaded into the interface table or when it was processed. These columns are for information purpose only and will not be used during actual import into Fusion.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. batch Identifier. Identifier that groups data into a batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Interface Row Id. Will be used to link this row with rows in the error table.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the row to be processed.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operation to be performed on a row such as Insert, Update etc.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: For Internal Use. Used to evaluate the operation to be performed on a row such as Insert, Update etc.

columns.name: PROMO_COUPON_CODE
columns.description: Promotion Coupon Code. It will be unique across promotions.

columns.name: PROMO_COUPON_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Promotion Coupon Identifier.

columns.name: PROMOTION_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Promotion Identifier.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Used by the file import wizard to relate a row in the interface table to the data file that was uploaded.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
